questions.promptEn:
[18-21] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
At school, Beatrice had a cooking class. To make a cake, she carefully took some eggs out of the refrigerator. When she turned around, ⓐ미끄러운 무언가를 밟았다. She was about to fall! But she didn’t. “That was close!” she thought. She almost made a mistake. Because of this, she began to feel nervous.
It was time for the talent show. The school gym was full of people. They said, “Look! That’s Perfect Girl!” Beatrice had ⓑbutterflies in her stomach. “Will I mess up? I’m worried,” she thought.
Beatrice threw an egg into the air. Next, she added a salt shaker. Finally, she added a water balloon. But then she felt something strange... Uh-oh! Beatrice’s nose started to itch. The salt shaker was full of... pepper! “ACHOO!” Beatrice missed the water balloon, and it fell to the floor. Then... OOPS! The egg broke on top of her head.

18 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 우리말을 괄호 안의 단어들을 이용하여 바르게 영작하시오. (필요시 어형을 바꿀 것)
(slippery, step on)

questions.sectionInstructionKo: 알맞은 것을 고르시오. 보기 중에서 하나를 누르세요. 번호는 쓰지 않아요.
questions.promptEn:
[22-25] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
For the first time ever, Beatrice made a mistake. What a surprise! She thought, “What should I do? Cry? Run off the stage?” Suddenly, she began to laugh loudly. The people looked at each other. Then everyone started to laugh together.
That night, Beatrice had a deep sleep. The next morning, she woke up with a smile. ⓐShe puts a white sock in her left foot... and a green sock in her right foot! Now, people no longer call her “Perfect Girl.” They just call her Beatrice.

23 What change happened to Beatrice the next morning?
choices: She did not go to school.
She was not perfect about her socks.
Her mother called Beatrice a perfect girl.

24 윗글의 내용을 바르게 이해하지 못한 사람은?
choices: 지수: Beatrice는 실수를 한 후 당황했어.
민지: Beatrice의 실수는 처음 있는 일이었어.
서연: Beatrice가 실수를 하자 관객들은 처음에 화를 냈어.
예나: Beatrice는 실수 후에 크게 웃기 시작했어.
도윤: Beatrice가 웃자 관객들도 함께 웃었어.
